overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: You do not read first. The teacher asks, you predict, you try it in a simulation, and only then come theory and practice with evidence.

challenge.title: Asked
challenge.lead: This is an entry diagnostic and does not count toward passing. You will be asked this question again in the last phase to see how far you have come.

explore.title: Experiment
explore.lead: Take each action, read what you observe, then answer the debrief question.

explain.title: Understand
explain.lead: Read each theory section; each one ties back to what you observed in the earlier phases.

apply.title: Apply
apply.lead: Read the code of the model, then solve a new situation and submit your evidence.

reflect.title: Interview again
reflect.lead: Same rubric as the Asked phase. The teacher compares each criterion before and after. A longer answer earns no extra points.

review.title: Review
review.lead: Review questions come due 1, 7 and 21 days later and are graded by their own rubric.
